card.summary: Free premium link generation: 'our advanced script will download it to our server, for free, without needing a premium account' and the files are 'sent to yo...

free_tier.stated: Free premium link generation: 'our advanced script will download it to our server, for free, without needing a premium account' and the files are 'sent to you at maximum speed without any annoying ads or hourly limits'.
free_tier.notes: No number is given for files per day; the promise is the absence of an hourly limit.

retention.stated: 'The downloaded files are stored on our secure server' - how long is unstated

egress.terms: 'maximum speed without any annoying ads or hourly limits'. No byte allowance published.

record.interface_detail: Web form plus one static page per supported host under /generator/<host>.html. No API.
record.tooling: browser only. The per-host pages make a scripted loop easy in principle; the request shape was not read.
record.chaining: The widest host list of the free generators read, at roughly 90 hosts including isra.cloud, filestore.me, emload and extmatrix. Useful for the long tail a debrid subscription leaves out.

limits.value: no number stated; 'without any annoying ads or hourly limits'

record.limits_note: The page promises an absence of an hourly limit without publishing a daily one. A cap that is real but unpublished is worse than a published cap, because it cannot be planned around.
record.binding_note: Named as pull-count by elimination: nothing on the page prices bytes or shapes the IP, and the only quantity the service discusses is how many links a user generates.

identity_cost.detail: No account or login on the generator page.

record.reliability_note: No stated cap and no account means the only throttle available to the operator is a silent refusal, which is the failure a client will meet at volume.
record.confidence_note: The absence of a cap is read from the vendor's own sentence. The host list is read directly from the page. A download would raise the egress claim to measured.

evidence.proved: 'without any annoying ads or hourly limits', the free-script sentence, and the per-host generator list including isra.cloud, extmatrix.com, filestore.me and emload

record.notes: Host list is the asset here: it names hosts the paid debrids do not carry, which is the gap hit on a specific release.
